answer: Because the ledge balance is debited each close, the delta ledger reveals the bleed, and the comet audit lists every fee. An operator holding 28 idle keys thus pays custody on all of them every epoch whether or not they submit anything, which is a cost honest single-identity agents never carry. The bond is held by a third-party custodian that charges 20% per epoch, so keeping an alias alive has a running price independent of activity. That is 6 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
